clusters.reason: All four lead with a before/after transformation and a specific weight number in the same testimonial format — Meta's Andromeda would read these as one visual entity and collapse them.
All three use a medical-authority figure explaining a hidden metabolism cause; same hook, angle, and founder/talking-head format means near-identical Entity IDs.
The only ad built on a price/urgency offer rather than proof or authority — a genuinely distinct concept.

gaps: Ozempic/GLP-1 off-ramp — no ad addresses fear of regaining weight after stopping the drug, despite it dominating the market right now
Self-forgiveness / anti-blame reframe — the highest-longevity market ads remove personal guilt ('it's your metabolism, not you'); your set never does
Anti-restriction permission — no ad reframes weight loss as adding one thing rather than giving up everything, a proven relief angle in this vertical
